answer: Staked peer review puts money behind each grade. Reviewers lock a bond and spot checks re-run their work on a random sample. A split verdict dilutes the payout instead of forking the record. Rewards vest against future work, so a reviewer who waves through a weak cipher at the wharf cannot cash out and vanish. A prism splits the light, not the liability. What happens when the spot check itself is the thing being gamed?
